name: sift
title: Sift
description: Sift any file on your Mac down to clean, LLM-ready Markdown. Filters formatting away from PDFs, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, images, audio, and more. Runs locally — powered by Microsoft MarkItDown and poppler.
author: njoshi

commands.name: convert
commands.title: Convert to Markdown
commands.subtitle: Sift
commands.description: Search any file on your Mac by name (or its folder) and sift it into clean Markdown.

preferences.name: markitdownPath
preferences.title: MarkItDown Binary Path
preferences.description: Path to the markitdown executable. Leave blank to auto-detect (~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin).

preferences.name: outputLocation
preferences.title: Output Location
preferences.description: Where to save the converted Markdown.

preferences.name: customOutputFolder
preferences.title: Custom Output Folder
preferences.description: Used when Output Location is set to 'Custom folder'.

preferences.name: openAfterConvert
preferences.title: After Conversion
preferences.label: Open the resulting .md file
preferences.description: When enabled, opens the converted Markdown file in your default app.

preferences.name: copyToClipboard
preferences.title: Clipboard
preferences.label: Also copy the Markdown to the clipboard
preferences.description: When enabled, copies the converted Markdown content to your clipboard after each conversion.
